$comment: Suspension is bounded, explicit and audited by design (OD-25). There is no permanent-ban fixture because no single function call can impose one: an end date is required.

what_each_side_sees.the_provider: set_online raises ERR_PROVIDER_SUSPENDED, and so does create_offer. Existing assigned jobs are NOT cancelled: they still owe the work and still get paid for it.
what_each_side_sees.a_customer: get_provider_card still returns the card, with is_available false. A suspension is not published to customers: it is an employment matter, not a rating.
